# ep9 unit container, container_version 4 (docs/adr/H35-aot-unit-format.md).
# Generated by ep9_unit::layout_text(). A change here needs a CONTAINER_VERSION bump.
# on-change: what check() gives when only this field differs from a unit that loads and
# the content hash is recomputed. Without the recompute every change is load-error.
#   load-error           S4 step 1 or 2: clean load error, no section used
#   source               S4 step 3: compile the source section
#   bytecode             S4 step 4: run the bytecode, drop native code
#   bytecode-drop-hints  S4 step 4: as bytecode, and drop the hints section
#   cpu-subset           load while every required bit is a host feature, else bytecode
#   source-flags         load while the flags are valid (rule below), else load-error
#   table                load-error, unless the table stays canonical (another unit)
#   ignored              load: an unknown compat flag bit is ignored
#   at-most-host         load while the value is at most the engine's, else bytecode
#   slot                 load while the value is a unit-data slot (below 64), else bytecode

header: 256 bytes, little-endian, frozen prefix 0..32
offset size field on-change
0 8 magic load-error
8 4 container_version load-error
12 4 header_size load-error
16 8 total_size load-error
24 4 section_count load-error
28 4 section_table_offset load-error
32 1 hash_alg load-error
33 1 header_flags load-error
34 6 reserved0 load-error
40 32 content_hash load-error
72 16 engine_build_id source
88 4 bytecode_abi source
92 4 value_encoding bytecode
96 4 object_layout bytecode
100 4 barrier bytecode
104 4 frame bytecode
108 4 ic bytecode
112 4 deopt_meta bytecode
116 4 fact_schema bytecode-drop-hints
120 1 target_arch bytecode
121 1 target_abi bytecode
122 1 heap_page_log2 bytecode
123 1 reserved1 load-error
124 4 source_flags source-flags
128 8 cpu_required cpu-subset
136 4 builtin_abi bytecode
140 4 compat_flags ignored
144 4 incompat_flags bytecode
148 4 vm_layout bytecode
152 4 runtime_table_len at-most-host
156 1 unit_data_slot slot
157 3 reserved3 load-error
160 8 root_shapes bytecode
168 8 codegen_flags bytecode
176 80 reserved2 load-error

section entry: 32 bytes; table at offset 256, 2..=64 entries, kinds strictly ascending (the named kinds, then the extensions)
offset size field on-change
0 4 kind table
4 4 flags table
8 8 offset table
16 8 size table
24 1 align_log2 table
25 7 reserved table

section kinds: id name align_log2 rule
1 text 16 native code: bytecode while any native contract version is 0
2 rodata 3 optional
3 rw_template 3 optional
4 bytecode 3 required
5 source 3 required
6 facts 3 optional
7 unwind 3 optional
8 debug 3 optional
9 signature 3 present iff header_flags bit 0; outside the hash
10 deps 3 reserved: present -> bytecode
11 snapshot_binding 3 reserved: present -> bytecode
extensions: kind >= 0x100, align_log2 3..=16, in the hash; entry flags bit 0 = native code needs it: an unknown extension with bit 0 -> bytecode, without -> skipped
entry flags: bit 0 only on an extension; a named kind has flags 0; other bits are 0

layout: each section starts at align_up(end of the previous section or of the table, 2^align_log2); padding bytes are 0; flags and reserved bytes are 0; the last section ends at total_size. The text is 64 KiB-aligned in the file; a loader maps it in place only from a 64 KiB-aligned address and copies it otherwise
hash: hash_alg 1 = SHA-256 of the whole unit with content_hash and the signature section's bytes set to 0
magic: 89 45 50 39 55 4e 0d 0a
fixed values: container_version 4, header_size 256, section_table_offset 256, hash_alg 1
header_flags: bit 0 signed
compat_flags: an unknown bit is ignored. incompat_flags: an unknown bit -> bytecode. The defined bits are in the code tables
runtime_table_len: the RuntimeTable entries the native code calls; above the engine's -> bytecode. unit_data_slot: 0..64 (0 = the engine's own unit), else bytecode; a slot in use in the isolate -> bytecode at load. root_shapes, codegen_flags: 8-byte hashes, 0 = none; another value -> bytecode
source_flags: defined mask 0xf07; bits 0-1 code kind (0 script, 1 module, 2 eval), bit 2 strict, bit 8 typescript, bits 9-11 TS flags only with bit 8
code tables (append-only; the H35 Freeze table): the target_arch and target_abi codes, the cpu bits and the compat and incompat bits are the lines of tests/golden/code-tables.txt (<table> <value> <name>), which only append: a value keeps its number and its meaning. A target code that the engine does not know never matches (0 = unknown), and a cpu bit that it does not know counts as missing: bytecode. The first 22 lines are the tables of container version 4 (SHA-256 ec077908730576ea7073e9de138a490683095c4c3f476c263afab8ba97ff6c27)
native contracts (version 0 = no native form): value_encoding object_layout barrier frame ic deopt_meta builtin_abi vm_layout
check order: step 1 header, total_size, table, required sections, signature flag; step 2 hash; step 3 engine_build_id, bytecode_abi; step 4 versions in header order (builtin_abi, vm_layout last), incompat_flags, runtime_table_len, root_shapes, codegen_flags, unit_data_slot, target, heap_page_log2, cpu_required, version 0 with a text section, a reserved section, an extension that native code needs
